paragraphs.source_en: Engine of growth Paid Viral Registration rate 42% 51% Activation 83% 92% Retention 21% 28% Referral 54% 64% Revenue 1% 11% Lifetime value (LTV) Minimal $0.20 per message Votizen’s story exhibits some common patterns. One of the most important to note is the acceleration of MVPs. The rst MVP took eight months, the next four months, then three, then one. Each time David was able to validate or refute his next hypothesis faster than before. How can one explain this acceleration? It is tempting to credit it to the product development work that had been going on. Many features had been created, and with them a fair amount of infrastructure. Therefore, each time the company pivoted, it didn’t have to start from scratch. But this is not the whole story. For one thing, much of the product had to be discarded between pivots.
